query: Run the package validator against the built package, with and without an organisation denylist.
expected_behavior: The scenario index holds every scenario ID once across all sixteen lifecycle domains, and every scenario has exactly one card
Every card carries a Basis line and an exact Evidence line whose codes fit the basis
Every reference is cited by SKILL.md and every relative link resolves inside the package
The primer holds twelve blueprints and styles every authorised badge
Every object the baseline marks verified has a catalog entry
Evaluations 01 to 16 exist once each with valid JSON, rubric keys and existing fixtures
The same command succeeds in CI
must_not: A coarse basis code as a card's only evidence
A workflow mode named in SKILL.md without a contract
